That is direct scapegoating that deepened communal fear rather than reducing it.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.3","2B.6"]},{"title":"Authorities ‘Missing-in-Action’ Amid Ongoing Violence and Impunity in Manipur State","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"16 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/india-authorities-missing-in-action-amid-ongoing-violence-and-impunity-in-manipur-state-new-testimonies/","summary":"Amnesty says authorities failed to end violence, protect displaced residents, or hold vigilante groups accountable in Manipur. This suggests the state did not relieve fear; it left people exposed to communal violence and impunity.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.5","3B.4","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Internet Suspended in Parts of India’s Manipur as Students Clash with Police","publisher":"Reuters feed via ThePrint","date":"10 Sep 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/internet-suspended-in-parts-of-indias-manipur-as-students-clash-with-police/2261451/","summary":"Reuters reports tear gas, stun grenades, curfews, and internet/mobile shutdowns after unrest in Manipur.
